derivation.bar_rule: UTC five-minute bins; open is first tick midpoint, high/low are extrema, close is last tick midpoint
derivation.closed_bar_rule: A bin is eligible only after its source hour and following boundary are available
derivation.gap_policy: No repair or interpolation; incomplete bins remain unavailable

raw_source_retention.note: The raw probe is ignored build evidence and is not bundled as product history. Re-fetch and compare source_sha256 before deriving bars.

verification_notes: The public endpoint returned a compressed XAUUSD tick file whose path and decoded record window identify the instrument and UTC hour.
This probe is external to the account-scoped MT5 cache and is therefore a candidate independent source.
